name: zero-income-return
description: Degenerate case: an untouched default return must produce zeroes everywhere (guards divide-by-zero on the effective rate and negative deductions).

source.publication: Engine contract; parameters per IRS Instructions for Form 1040 (2025)

derivation: No income: total income, AGI, taxable income, tax, NIIT, credits are all zero.
Standard deduction (single, 2025): $15,750 per the Instructions for Form 1040 (2025) and the IRS VITA Standard Deduction page.
Effective rate must be 0, not NaN: engine guard on AGI <= 0.
